capabilities.title: Appearance, locale, date/time/time-zone, and Article language defaults
capabilities.contract: General Settings supports device-local or explicit IANA time zones, device-local date and time formatting, explicit date and time formats, and Article and translation language defaults. Revision History honors saved formatting while relative Article Library activity remains time-zone independent.

capabilities.title: Configurable application shortcuts
capabilities.contract: Settings can persist command overrides and expose conflict-aware shortcut configuration.
limitations: Complete workspace-action wiring remains tracked separately.

capabilities.title: OpenAI connections and active connection
capabilities.contract: Authors can add connections, prevent duplicate environment-variable names, choose an active connection, test it, and confirm deletion without exposing secret values.

capabilities.title: Default model and per-skill overrides
capabilities.contract: A default model and per-skill overrides apply to six built-in skills through provider-compatible requests; legacy operation overrides normalize on read without exposing unknown keys.

capabilities.title: Available model list refresh
capabilities.contract: The active OpenAI connection can refresh its available model list for model selection.
capabilities.persistence: Server-side OpenAI refresh only; the resulting list is not persisted.

capabilities.title: Built-in profiles and persisted default for new Articles
capabilities.contract: Built-in profiles supply character-limit guidance and the selected default applies to new Articles; Article-specific selection is supported.

capabilities.title: Active data directory
capabilities.contract: The active local data directory and server-only environment values are determined at startup; project .env values are loaded before the local service starts and Settings displays the active data directory.
capabilities.persistence: Startup configuration rather than a Settings-managed value.

capabilities.title: Backup destination, schedule, and retention
capabilities.contract: Authors can save a backup destination, schedule, and retention policy.
limitations: Validation, backup snapshots, and retention execution remain incomplete.

scenarios.title: General time-zone preferences persist with accessible guidance
scenarios.event: The author selects an explicit IANA time zone or restores the system setting.
expected: The preference is saved with an accessible label, hint, and timestamp preview.
forbidden: Changing display preferences does not rewrite saved timestamps or Revision history.

scenarios.title: Key-binding overrides remain conflict-aware
preconditions: The author configures an application shortcut.
scenarios.event: A key binding is normalized and checked against effective commands.
expected: The override can be persisted and conflicts are identified.
forbidden: An override does not silently replace a conflicting command.

scenarios.title: AI connection metadata is managed without secrets
preconditions: The author is in the AI Settings section.
scenarios.event: The author adds, selects, or confirms removal of a connection.
expected: Only connection labels and environment-variable names are managed; duplicate names are blocked.
forbidden: API key values are not shown or persisted.

scenarios.title: Model preferences resolve for built-in skills
preconditions: A default model or skill override is saved.
scenarios.event: A new editorial request is prepared.
expected: The applicable built-in-skill override or default model is resolved.
forbidden: Unknown legacy override keys are not exposed.

scenarios.title: Available models can be refreshed without becoming settings data
preconditions: An active AI connection is configured.
scenarios.event: The author refreshes the available model list.
expected: The current provider list is offered for selection.
forbidden: The refreshed list is not persisted as a model preference.

scenarios.title: Built-in publishing profile default survives reload
preconditions: The author selects a supported built-in profile.
scenarios.event: The service saves and reloads the profile default.
expected: The selected default is returned for new Articles.

scenarios.title: Settings show the configured local data location
preconditions: The local service starts with a configured data directory.
scenarios.event: The author opens Data & backups Settings.
expected: The active local data location is shown.
forbidden: The UI does not imply that the directory can already be changed in Settings.

scenarios.title: Backup policy preferences are persisted separately from backups
preconditions: The author opens Data & backups Settings.
scenarios.event: The author changes destination, schedule, or retention preferences.
expected: The local backup policy is saved through Settings.
forbidden: Saving policy preferences does not claim that backup snapshots or retention execution are complete.
